newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - December 5.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - December 5.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw Stock Exchange was at 3.6 million zlotys on Thursday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 957 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on June 12, 1998 traded at 94.70 zlotys.
* 680 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on June 12, 1998 traded at 94.75 zlotys.
* 2,300 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on October 12, 2001, traded at 80.95 zlotys.
